verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single docs line saying users can 'Generate Terraform configurations using Azure Copilot'. That shows a built-in AI assistant exists and can be handed at least one task (IaC generation), but nothing shows broader delegation of tasks inside the portal or CLI. Missing for 10: documentation of Azure Copilot's scope and the range of tasks it can perform or act on, evidence of agentic execution beyond code generation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
